city_local_shrine_1 = {
	type_icon = "regular_buildings/sacred_pool.dds"
	next_building = city_local_shrine_2
	cost_gold = regular_building_cost_tier_1
	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	triggered_name = {
		trigger = { faith.religion = religion:christianity_religion }
		reference = "city_town_church_1"
	}
	triggered_name = {
		trigger = { faith.religion = religion:islam_religion }
		reference = "city_town_mosque_1"
	}
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_holding_type = castle_holding }
			scope:holder = { government_has_flag = government_is_republic }
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	province_modifier = {
		popular_opinion_add = 1
	}
	county_modifier = {
		monthly_popular_opinion_change = regular_building_popular_opinion_growth_tier_1
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_incense_sell_price_mult = price_holding_district_need
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_incense
		amount = holding_district_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			county_modifier = {
				monthly_popular_opinion_change = 0.1
			}
		}
	}
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_general_building_modifier = yes
		ai_pious_building_preference_modifier = yes
		ai_capital_preference_modifier = yes
		ai_holding_district_building_modifier = { LEVEL = 1 }
	}
}
